method: 20 flags drawn with seed 5924 from flip+mixed (9 flip, 11 mixed, proportional); for each, page image(s) from images.sourcelibrary.org read by eye against the stored OCR text. A flip is correct if the leaves are in the proposed language and not substantially Latin; a mixed is correct if both Latin and the proposed language are on the book's own leaves as text (not a single quotation).
